Added occupied S2 donor canonical 19 joins the original CH2-frontier/HSS-radical source 20-22. At separation the occupations are 2/1/1/1; near 19 and 22 carry C/S bonding-antibonding character, 20 sulfur p and 21 carbon p. Near occupations are 1.96228,1.49558,1.00285,0.53930 (DZ) and 1.96279,1.49549,1.00287,0.53885 (TZ). This corrects the missing carbon-frontier character of the CAS(3,3) near solution without adding other valence bonds. One Q and one D have total weights 0.5 each. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. variants.name: candidate
variants.purpose: Reviewed 2026-10-25. HCS + H2S product exit: HCS pi/radical/pi-star from source canonical 19,21,22 and selected natural 20-22. The extra occupied HCS orbital tested in CAS(5,4) changes the near-minus-far CASSCF energy by about -0.22/-0.21 kcal/mol in DZ/TZ; it is not retained. Only repaired v8 results are used; obsolete core-substituted results are excluded. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote. Outer dividing surfaces use fragment COM separation; the correction scan uses the mapped interfragment anchor of the saved product complex. Preserve both explicitly configured grids and the product-side geometry.
